rows.en: We won't be able to shake them off. ...We have no choice but to fight.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We don't have much time left... but for now, let's focus on the enemy in front of us.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The situation has reached a critical point.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We have confirmed that the planetoid Axis has started moving toward the Gate of Zedan.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: At this rate, the two will collide within a few dozen minutes.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: If the fleets in the area get caught up in it, it will be the worst possible outcome.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Neo Zeon has outmaneuvered us. To think this was their aim from the start...
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Head for the Gate of Zedan at once.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: To think that Londo Bell, a gathering of the elite, would actually be defeated...
